responsibility: Implements the gcov reporting program that turns gcno/gcda execution data into human-readable source coverage reports. It reads coverage notes and count files through the shared gcov I/O layer, reconstructs per-function control-flow graphs and block/arc execution counts, maps blocks and branches back to source lines and files, computes coverage and branch statistics, and emits annotated source listings and related structured output such as colored or detailed branch/function summaries. This file owns the report-generation side of gcov, distinct from compiler instrumentation or offline profile editing.
